n: NC State color chemistry and AI virtual pH meter curriculum
t: A weeklong high school unit that trains a neural network to read pH test strips.
steps: Find the Journal of Chemical Education article from NC State for the unit materials.
Buy pH test strips and gather everyday liquids.
Ask IT to install Orange on student or lab computers.
Download Orange while online and test it.
Practice taking photos of strips in the same light.
Prepare a pH meter for comparison readings.
Plan one week of class time.
